1. An apparatus comprising:
a capture device configured to generate pixel data corresponding to an exterior view from a vehicle; and
a processor configured to (i) process said pixel data arranged as video frames, (ii) perform computer vision operations on said video frames to detect (a) a moving object in said video frames and (b) one or more stationary objects adjacent to said vehicle, (iii) determine a predicted path of said moving object,
(iv) determine a probability of said moving object colliding with said vehicle based on said predicted path, (v) perform said computer vision operations on said video frames to measure distances to said stationary objects and (vi) generate a control signal when said probability is greater than a pre-determined threshold, wherein (i) said control signal is configured to enable an autonomous movement of said vehicle in order to move said vehicle to avoid said predicted path of said moving object,
(ii) said predicted path is determined by tracking said moving object over time in a sequence of video frames,
(iii) said autonomous movement comprises a low speed avoidance maneuver within said distances measured,
(iv) said distances measured define an amount of available space around said vehicle, and (v) said autonomous movement comprises moving said vehicle to avoid said predicted path of said moving object while 26 staying within said available space between said vehicle and said stationary objects.
2. The apparatus according to claim 1, wherein (i) said vehicle is parked in a parking lot and (ii) said processor is further configured to measure second distances of lines of a parking space occupied by said vehicle to define a bounds of said parking space.
3. The apparatus according to claim 2, wherein said processor is further configured to (i) generate said control signal to enable said autonomous movement of said vehicle to avoid said predicted path of said moving object while staying within said bounds of said parking space and (ii) if said predicted path of said moving object is determined to collide with said vehicle while within said bounds of said parking space then generate said control signal to enable said autonomous movement to move said vehicle outside of said bounds of said parking space and within said available space between said vehicle and said stationary objects.
4. The apparatus according to claim 1, wherein said processor is further configured to determine an approach angle of said moving object based on said predicted path and said autonomous movement comprises moving said vehicle in a direction based on said approach angle in order to provide more room for said moving 6 object.
1 5. The apparatus according to claim 1, wherein (A) said control signal is further configured to provide a response and (B) said processor is further configured to (i) continue performing said computer vision operations on said video frames after said control signal is generated to determine a result of said response,
(ii) said result comprises whether said moving object (a) collided with said vehicle or (b) would have collided with said vehicle if said response was not performed and (iii) compare said result with said probability to determine an accuracy of said probability based on said computer vision operations.
6. The apparatus according to claim 5, further configured to upload said accuracy of said probability and said video frames used to determine said probability to a remote device, wherein said video frames are used by said remote device for training said computer vision operations.
7. The apparatus according to claim 1, wherein (i) said computer vision operations performed by said processor are further configured to detect portions of said stationary objects that comprise a component that is capable of movement and (ii) said processor is further configured to determine a potential event based on said computer vision operations performed on component of stationary objects.
8. The apparatus according to claim 7, wherein (i) one 2 of said component that is capable of movement of said stationary 3 objects is a car door, (ii) said processor is further configured to determine a potential trajectory of said car door and (iii) said potential event is damage to said vehicle from said car door based on said potential trajectory.
9. The apparatus according to claim 8, wherein (i) said processor is further configured to generate said control signal in response to said potential event and (ii) said autonomous movement is implemented for adjusting a location of said vehicle based on said potential trajectory of said component that is capable of movement of said stationary objects.
10. The apparatus according to claim 1, wherein (A) said vehicle is an electric vehicle comprising a battery that supplies power for said electric vehicle and (B) said processor is further configured to (i) read an available charge of said battery of said vehicle and (ii) disable performing said computer vision operations on said video frames when said available charge is below a pre-determined charge threshold.
11. An apparatus comprising:
a capture device configured to generate pixel data corresponding to an exterior of a vehicle; and a processor configured to (i) process said pixel data arranged as video frames, (ii) perform computer vision operations on said video frames to detect a moving object in said video 7 frames, (iii) determine a predicted path of said moving object, 8 (iv) determine a probability of said moving object colliding with said vehicle based on said predicted path, (v) determine a course correction to prevent said moving object from colliding with said vehicle, (vi) generate discrete steps to perform said course correction, and (vii) generate a control signal when said probability is greater than a pre-determined threshold, wherein (i) said control signal is configured to enable an audio output comprising a verbal instruction,
(ii) said predicted path is determined by tracking said moving object over time in a sequence of video frames,
(iii) said verbal instruction comprises said discrete steps of said course correction, and
(iv) said discrete steps comprise instructions for a driver of said moving object.
12. The apparatus according to claim 11, wherein said control signal is further configured to provide a response that enables honking a horn of said vehicle.
13. The apparatus according to claim 11, wherein said vehicle is parked in a parking space and does not have an occupant.
14. The apparatus according to claim 11, wherein (A) said control signal is further configured to provide a response and (B) said response comprises (i) said processor generating a video stream from said video frames, (ii) said apparatus communicating said video stream to a display implemented by said moving object 6 and (iii) said video stream comprises said discrete steps of said course correction.
15. The apparatus according to claim 11, wherein said vehicle is stationary when said vehicle is idling at a stop light and an occupant is operating said vehicle.
16. The apparatus according to claim 11, wherein said apparatus is configured to perform automatic collision detection, warning, avoidance and prevention in parked cars.
17. The apparatus according to claim 11, wherein (i) said processor is further configured to (a) record a subset of said video frames and (b) add annotations to said subset of said video frames, (ii) said subset of said video frames comprise said video frames that were used to determine said probability, (iii) said annotations comprise information about said moving object and (iv) said apparatus is further configured to communicate said subset of said video frames to an owner of said vehicle.
18. The apparatus according to claim 11, wherein (i) said processor is further configured to determine autonomous movement of said vehicle to avoid said moving object in response to said predicted path, (ii) said control signal is further configured to enable said autonomous movement of said vehicle and (iii) said 6 autonomous movement comprises a low speed avoidance maneuver within 7 available space around said vehicle measured using said computer vision operations.
19. A method for avoiding a collision in a parked car, comprising the steps of:
generating pixel data corresponding to an exterior view from a vehicle using a capture device;
processing said pixel data arranged as video frames using a video processor;
performing computer vision operations on said video frames to detect a moving object in said video frames;
determining a predicted path of said moving object;
determining a probability of said moving object colliding with said vehicle based on said predicted path;
determining whether said vehicle is stationary;
performing said computer vision operations on said video frames to measure distances to lines of a parking space occupied by said vehicle; and
generating a control signal when (a) said vehicle is stationary and (b) said probability is greater than a pre- determined threshold, wherein (i) said control signal is configured to enable an autonomous movement of said vehicle in order to move said vehicle to avoid said predicted path of said moving object, (ii) said predicted path is determined by tracking 23 said moving object over time in a sequence of video frames, 24 (iii) said autonomous movement comprises a low speed avoidance maneuver within said distances measured,
(iv) said distances measured define a bounds of said parking space, and
(v) said autonomous movement comprises moving said vehicle to avoid said predicted path of said moving object while staying within said bounds of said parking space. 103 104 105 106 107 108 109 110
